_comment: Per-skill dependency manifest read by scripts/preflight.sh (the engine is vendored identically across the family; this file is where request-review differs). Base checks — git work tree, gh installed+authenticated, jq — are always run by the engine.
notes: Sending needs the Slack MCP (slack_send_message / slack_send_message_draft); only the harness can check MCP availability. Envelope formatting, policy, and dedup all work without it.
